details: It's always a bit awkward when you join a world and are immediately greeted, blue transparent man to blue transparent man. It would be much nicer if you could defer joining the world until the avatars for players in the world are ready. Plus, on the loading screen, the CPU and GPU are much less busy than they'll be when the world is being rendered, so loading (for cached avatars) should go much faster.
title: Add option to delay spawning into the world until your/everyone's avatar loads
